orders.text:
WPMS No. 331 of 2015 
Hon’ble U.C.Dhyani, J. 
 Mr. Nagesh Agarwal, Advocate, 
present for the writ petitioners. 
 Mr. P.S.Bisht, learned Standing 
Counsel, present for the State/respondent 
no.3. 
 Petitioners have moved the present 
writ petition being aggrieved against the 
judgment and order dated 03.01.2004 
passed in Consolidation Case No. 3496, 
Roop Chandra vs. D.A.V. Higher 
Secondary School, Bhagwan Pur, under 
Section 9Ka (2) of the U.P. Consolidation 
of Holdings Act, order dated 30.05.2012, 
passed in Appeal No. 443, and the order 
dated 19.09.2014 passed by Deputy 
Director of Consolidation/Addl. 
Collector, Haridwar, Camp Roorkee in 
Revision No. 143 of 2012-13 Indra Singh 
vs. Gram Sabha and others. 
 Issue notices to respondents no. 1 
and 2. Steps be taken within a week. 
 List after the notices are served 
upon them. 
 Liberty is however granted to the 
counsel for the writ petitioners to make a 
mention if there is likelihood of 
dispossession of the petitioners from the 
land in question. 
 (Urgency Application No. 583 of 
2015 also stands disposed of.) 
 (U.C.Dhyani, J.) Vacation Judge 
 02.02.2015 
Kaushal
